narration:37:1510677026:0.text: You use the key to open Sedecim's chest.
narration:37:1510677026:0.source_cn: 你用钥匙打开了十六的胸腔

narration:38:1510677027:0.text: Hidden inside is a diamond-shaped crystal, glowing faintly.
narration:38:1510677027:0.source_cn: 一颗隐隐闪耀着微光的菱形结晶藏于其中

narration:39:1510677028:0.text: As the crystal is removed, Sedecim becomes a motionless, silent puppet once more.
narration:39:1510677028:0.source_cn: 随着结晶被取出，十六彻底变回了无法行动和言语的木偶

say:47:1510677031:1.text: I can feel the magic lingering on this crystal.
say:47:1510677031:1.source_cn: 能感受到晶石上残留的魔力。

say:48:1510677032:0.text: It must have taken generations of priests pouring their magic into this, year after year, to make it shine as bright as the sun.
say:48:1510677032:0.source_cn: 只有数代祭司年累月地赋予它魔力，才能让它放出足以媲美太...

say:49:1510677033:1.text: Perhaps that magic is what gave Sedecim consciousness and the ability to move.
say:49:1510677033:1.source_cn: 或许是凭借这些魔力，十六才拥有了意识和行动能力。

say:51:1510677034:0.text: Even without a soul. What a miracle.
say:51:1510677034:0.source_cn: 明明没有灵魂。一个奇迹。

say:52:1510677035:1.text: ... Let's return to the Harvest Altar. We'll use Sedecim's final gift to drive out the darkness.
say:52:1510677035:1.source_cn: ……回丰饶祭坛，用十六的心，驱散黑暗吧。

say:53:1510677036:0.text: Just as Sedecim said, this will be the light of hope.
say:53:1510677036:0.source_cn: 如同十六所言，这将是希望之光。

cinematic_dialogue:1:1510610003:.text: It seems the darkness swallows all light.
cinematic_dialogue:1:1510610003:.source_cn: 看来火光会被黑暗吞噬

cinematic_dialogue:1:1510614002:.text: It's like these buildings were crushed...
cinematic_dialogue:1:1510614002:.source_cn: 这些建筑就像是被捏碎了……
cinematic_dialogue:1:1510614002:.male: It's like these buildings were crushed...
cinematic_dialogue:1:1510614002:.female: It's like these buildings were crushed...

cinematic_dialogue:1:1510629002:.text: They snuck up on us in the dark.
cinematic_dialogue:1:1510629002:.source_cn: 它们是趁暗偷偷接近的
cinematic_dialogue:1:1510629002:.male: They snuck up on us in the dark.
cinematic_dialogue:1:1510629002:.female: They snuck up on us in the dark.

cinematic_dialogue:1:1510653002:.text: Don't just stand there! Take care of them!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1510657003:.text: I think something fell on the ground.
cinematic_dialogue:1:1510657003:.male: I think something fell on the ground.
cinematic_dialogue:1:1510657003:.female: I think something fell on the ground.

cinematic_dialogue:1:1510661004:.text: Heed the call of the living!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1510664002:.text: There are a lot of glowing souls here, too.
cinematic_dialogue:1:1510664002:.source_cn: 这里也有很多发光的灵魂

cinematic_dialogue:1:1510699701:.text: It's time to prove your faith!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1510699701:.source_cn: 证明你们信仰的时候到了

cinematic_dialogue:1:1510699702:.text: Go forth! Let the rivers run red with blood of the Wildborn!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1510699702:.source_cn: 去吧！让雅库伯尔血流成河！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1510699703:.text: Slaughter the savages! Avenge our fallen soldiers!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1510699703:.source_cn: 屠尽雅库伯尔！为死去的将士报仇！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1510696002:.text: They're the spirits of the dead...

cinematic_dialogue:1:1510698002:.text: You... You won't get away with this!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1510698002:.male: You... You won't get away with this!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1510698002:.female: You... You won't get away with this!

cinematic_summary:1.text: As the souls merged with the crystal, emitting a light that pierced through the darkness, the God of Harvest finally materialized.
cinematic_summary:1.source_cn: 灵魂化作一道道光芒汇入结晶光源，划破了黑暗，躲藏于此的丰饶神随之现身。
